endpoint_proposal.derivation: integrate the linear interpolation of the two most recent exact endpoint free rates across the proposed physical-time span
endpoint_proposal.initial_current_rate: one new exact evaluation at the committed 16 ms terminal state
endpoint_proposal.initial_previous_rate: hash-validated exact anchor rate at 15.75 ms

initialization.current_rate: evaluate exactly once before the first endpoint proposal
initialization.poincare_memory: retain start coordinate, section normal, departure=true, negative_side=false, and the committed switch count

outputs.every_accepted_segment: Hermite coefficients, primitive endpoint, coordinate endpoint, rate endpoint, elapsed time, Poincare state, and cumulative ledgers
outputs.every_attempt: predictor, exact endpoint, exact rate, defects, physical audits, acceptance reasons, cost, and hashes
outputs.restart: bitwise arbitrary-segment restart and suffix replay

path_parameterization.implementation_note: endpoint proposals use physical-time spans while accepted Hermite segments retain both arclength geometry and clock

post_cycle_authorization: definitions-only matched-path refinement and global cycle-map certificate; no slow closure or reduced evolution yet

sequence: propose endpoint coordinate with variable-step AB2
retract endpoint exactly and run every physical audit
evaluate exact original free field at the endpoint
form the cubic Hermite segment from exact endpoint states and rates
on every fourth tentative acceptance, exact-retract and exact-evaluate the Hermite midpoint
accept and propagate only after every applicable gate passes

terminal_events.cycle: after the inherited positive departure, first visit the negative side and then localize a same-positive-orientation return to the original Poincare section with an exact event audit
terminal_events.equilibrium_candidate: speed <=0.1 of the initial committed speed; this stops for a separate stationary-residual and stability certificate
